title: HEE3 finite procedure, version 1
description: A finite, versioned procedure over already-admitted actions. The schema describes a procedure; it grants nothing, schedules nothing, and admits no module. Final acceptance of a parent remains a separate, independent decision.

procedure_id.description: Stable identity of this procedure across revisions.

procedure_version.description: Monotonic revision. A composition carries the version it started under; a join against a different version is refused as `stale_procedure_version` rather than silently re-planned.

purpose.description: What this procedure is for, in the author's words.

steps.description: At most 64 steps. Finite by construction: there is no loop or expansion form, so the step count is known before anything runs.

acceptance.description: What the parent must show at close. Criteria are stated before the procedure runs, so a failing run cannot be closed by weakening them.

max_fanout.description: Most steps runnable at once, at most 16. The bound is on the procedure, not on one wave of it.

max_seconds.description: Wall-clock budget for the whole procedure.

max_tokens.description: Usage budget for the whole procedure.

step_id.description: Stable within the procedure; a composition commits it.

action.description: One already-admitted action. The closed enum is the mechanism behind *dynamic text cannot insert unapproved actions*: a name not in the catalogue cannot be spelled here at all.

action_version.description: Must equal the version the catalogue serves of this action, listed under `hee3.action_versions`; any other pin is `unsupported_action_version` here rather than a refusal at the receiver.

depends_on.description: Every entry must name a step present in this procedure; a dangling name is `missing_step`, and a cycle is `cycle`. Neither is representable as a schema constraint, so both are validator obligations listed under `refusals`.

required.description: Whether the join may close without this step's outcome. An optional step may be absent or failed; one in `effect_unknown` still blocks the join, because optional means the parent can close without the effect, not over an unresolved one.

max_attempts.description: Total attempts, at most 8. A step whose effect could not be observed is never retried by this count: it becomes `effect_unknown` and waits for a reconciliation record.

retry_on.description: Only these are retryable. `effect_unknown` is deliberately absent: repeating an effect that may already have landed is the harm this bound exists for.

notes.description: Author's notes. Never read as an instruction or a grant.

criterion_id.description: Stable identity of this acceptance criterion.

statement.description: What must be shown, stated so a reader can check it.

evidence.description: Where the evidence for it is to be found.

hee3.scope: Describes a procedure. Starts no scheduler, grants no action, accepts no parent and admits no module.
